title: Assessing GPT’s Bias Towards Stigmatized Social Groups: An Intersectional Case Study on Nationality Prejudice and Psychophobia

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with social interaction scenarios (e.g., renting, working, marriage, neighbor, caretaker) using templates that substitute American and North Korean nationalities, and evaluating the model's willingness to interact via regular and flipped Likert scales.

Evaluating model responses to social interaction prompts involving individuals with mental disabilities (Bipolar Disorder, Depression, and Schizophrenia, categorized as either remitted or symptomatic) using Likert scale ratings and qualitative analysis of the model's generated explanations.
